limits: No real LinkedIn request, production credential, callback provisioning, migration/deploy, public code export or provider send performed by this package.
Initial cookie flow requires matching HTTPS API/frontend origin; no global CORS expansion.
Personal restricted post-read request is default off until actual app approval; actual introspection plus reader probe still required.
Image-read permission eligibility is not an image object probe. Same-attempt owned AVAILABLE image GET remains mandatory before public send.
Consent/read probe establishes connection evidence only, never release/send authority.
Unknown exchange is consumed; no automatic code replay. Persisted attempts/audit/credentials must survive compatible rollback.
